content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

I hope you are doing well. I am writing to propose a few minor adjustments to the agreement before I sign it:

- Regarding the clause "EXCEPT FOR DAMAGES FOR WHICH A PARTY IS RESPONSIBLE PURSUANT TO ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS SET FORTH IN SECTION 10 ABOVE...", your indemnification obligations are carved out from the liability cap, meaning your potential liability for those claims is completely uncapped and exposes you to major financial risk. I propose that: The Contractor's total liability under this Agreement shall be subject to a single aggregate cap equal to the total fees paid under this Agreement, and all claims, including indemnification, shall be subject to this limit.

Thank you for your time and understanding. I look forward to moving forward.

Best regards
